verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party marketing directly claims every element of the story: paying contractors in 150+ countries, in local currency, with compliant contracts included. That claim rests on a single homepage line, with no detailed docs or API endpoints for contractor payments or contract generation, and nothing independent backs it up. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the contractor payment and contract workflow, specifics on contract compliance by jurisdiction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts

citations.quote: Pay contractors in 150+ countries at near-Google FX rates. Local currency, compliant contracts, and instant invoicing included.
